The current full-text live rows still recompute 72/72 route-correct matches, zero observed routed mismatch and full schedule parity, so the hash inconsistency does not establish a technical route failure. Promotion would therefore be a provenance false positive, while scientific REJECTED would overstate a technical negative not supported by the physical rows.
